description: Change/rename a form field (rename field, edit property, update column). Name, description, position, options for select/radio, default value, required, sizes, uniqueness. Does not change the field's type.

allow_new_values.description: For select fields only. true — users can add new options right from the record form («+ Add new value...» in the list). Default false.

average_table_column.description: Not for an average over the rows linked to this record: their sum (linked_records + linked_column) divided by a linked_records_count. formula_type average is refused by this tool.

average_table_ref_column.description: formula_type average: the link field in that other table that points at this form, by id or name; may be left out when only one table links here

choices.description: New options for select / radio / checkbox (replaces all current ones)

column.description: Only for a linked_column field: the id of the field of the linked table it shows (get_form_fields of that table lists the ids). Changes WHAT the column shows; written here, beside settings — not inside settings

default.description: Default value. ⚠️ For select/radio/checkbox this key carries THE LIST of options itself — to set the option selected at the START, use `initial`.

dependent.description: rel only: true — the list offers only the rows linked to what another field of the same form holds (Country → City, Stage → Check point), with depends_from_field_id; false — the list is whole again

depends_from_field_id.description: rel only: the field of the same form (name or id) whose pick narrows this list — itself a link to a table that the linked table links to as well

display_as_image.description: true — show the URL as a picture in the table (url fields only)

field.description: Array of field IDs or constants ['Constant', 'text'] for formula_type=formula

field_id.description: Field ID — an alternative to field_name

field_name.description: Field name (resolved to the ID automatically)

file_preview.description: file fields only: inline — audio (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg), video (mp4, webm, mov) and PDF play or show right in the table and the record instead of a link; none — the link (the default). This is what «see / play the files inside the table instead of downloading them» means for a file field.

formula_link_column.description: formula_type=link: ID of the field with the table/form name

formula_type.description: Formula type: formula (arithmetic/concatenation), function (built-in functions + Ruby), link (clickable link), total (sum), average (average). REQUIRED for field_type=formula.

func_fields.description: IDs of all fields used in func/script_body. REQUIRED for formula_type=function — without it the formula is not recalculated.

hide_from_public_form.description: true — remove the field from the PUBLIC form (the form widget: what is put on a website or sent to clients as a link), keeping it in the internal record form. This is how a short request form is made: the table has 30 fields, and outside a person fills in four. false — bring it back. ⚠️ Not to be confused with `visible` (the field in the RECORD form, inside) and with `hidden_fields` in set_table_permission (hide from a particular group) — these are three DIFFERENT things.

image_url.description: image fields only: what a click on the picture does — popup (a gallery over the table, the default), full_size (the picture in a new tab), record (opens the record), url (a link kept in another field: pass image_url_column), nothing

image_url_column.description: with image_url=url: the id of the url field whose link the picture opens

initial.description: For select/radio: which option is selected in a new form (e.g. the status «Pending»). An empty string removes the starting choice. For ordinary fields the starting value is set by `default`.

operand_is.description: Operand type for formula_type=formula: numbers, decimal, text, days, hours, year. REQUIRED when formula_type=formula.

operation.description: Operators between the fields: +, -, *, / (one fewer than the number of fields)

position.description: Position in the form (ordinal number from 1)

precision.description: Digits after the decimal point (for float)

rel_show_field_id.description: ONLY for rel fields (a link to another form). Changes WHICH field of the target record is shown in this rel field — e.g. "show the name instead of the date" / "show the name instead of id/date" for a linked column = exactly this parameter, NOT a rename of the field (name). Take the field ID from the target form's list of fields (get_form_fields of the target entity, or rel_info.target_entity_fields from describe_project/get_form_fields — rel_info is present only for rel fields).

required.description: true — the field is required, false — no longer required

script_body.description: Ruby code for func=4. Rules: the result goes into the variable 'a', the last line is 'a'; field names in single quotes 'field_name'.to_f; def/while/puts/return/require are forbidden; aggregating subforms through .to_f is FORBIDDEN (use linked_column for that).

settings.description: Any other setting of the field, as setting: value pairs in the product's own names — totals and averages under a column, barcode / QR code, an input mask, several files at once, a list's options side by side, pages of a long form, address help, edit in the table, how many fields share a row, a subform's rows (how many, the add link, hidden fields) and what the table shows of a subform or a list of linked records (one column or a small table of chosen columns, their order). Call get_field_types with field_type for the settings that fit one type. Example: {"show_db_total_row": true}. A setting that does not fit the field's type is refused by name.

show_file_url_as_image.description: file and image fields only: true — an icon (file) or the thumbnail (image) in the table instead of the file name

start_from.description: Starting value of an autoincrement field

time_settings.description: time field: how the time is picked. clock_system "12h" | "24h"; control_type "dropdown" | "slider"; units: { hour | minute | second | millisec | microsec: { show: true|false, min, max, step, grid } } — e.g. {"units": {"minute": {"step": 15}, "second": {"show": false}}}. Only what is passed changes

total_table_column.description: Not for a sum over the rows linked to this record — that is a linked_records field and a linked_column over it (937). formula_type total is refused by this tool.

total_table_ref_column.description: Not for a sum over the rows linked to this record (see total_table_column).

truncates_after.description: Cut the text after N characters in the table

uniq_columns.description: For uniq_validation=multi: an array of names or IDs of the other fields together with which uniqueness is checked. For example ["Last name", "Date of birth"] — the combination Field+Last name+Date must be unique.

uniq_error_message.description: A custom error message when uniqueness is broken

uniq_validation.description: Type of the uniqueness check: none — no check; simple — this field is unique on its own; multi — unique in combination with other fields (given in uniq_columns). Example: the Email field + uniq_validation=multi + uniq_columns=["Company"] — the pair Email+Company must be unique.

validations.description: The field's checks (the recommended way, instead of validate_options). They check the text typed into the add or edit form, in the browser: none reads a date's weekday, a holiday, opening hours or other records (see the instruction's VALIDATIONS).

visible.description: Whether the field's column is shown on the table's PUBLIC page (the page, a found record, one record's own page). It does not hide the field from the form or from the owner's own table. For a public page prefer update_public_page hide_columns / show_columns: it keeps the page's search in step

name: update_field
